What these screens look like as nowrun

Nine screens. Left is what a nowrun app shows today, rebuilt from the player's own stylesheets. Right is the same moment, cleaned up. Nothing here changes how the player works.

For engineering · what goes live

Everything below is one change. It uses the flags and components the player already has; nothing new is introduced. Config is per app, so set it on the nowrun default, not on one app.

Code

Each row is an existing component. The change is its markup, styles and strings, to match the tab named.

TodayComponentChangeTab
logo hold, then videocomponents/preloaderThe customPreloader branch renders the launch screen: app icon, name, hairline, status line. Status reads state.play.queuePosition. Label colour follows the background (it is hardcoded white today).Launching

and the modal abovemodals/session, components/session-endRestyle. Strings *Head / *Msg for the five types, one line each. Two components draw the time-limit ending; render one.Session ended

common/android-error-modalRestyle. Keep the crash type as a small line.App crashed
red toast; cream strip for networknetwork-status, spot-instances/session-end-warning-toastOne toast style for both.Connection lost

Assets

All at github.com/arastu-bst/nowrun-preview/tree/main/assets. Copy into the repo; do not hot-link.

FileUsed for
screens.cssThe styles for the six proposed screens. Same values this page renders.
strings.mdEvery string on those screens, against the locale key it replaces.
preloader-bg-light.png · preloader-bg-dark.pngcustomPreloader.backgroundUrl. Flat colour, 1920×1080, because that slot stretches the image. Light is the one to use; dark is there if it is ever wanted.
nowrun-app-placeholder.svgFallback app icon. The boot animation is inside the file, so it plays as a plain <img>.
nowrun-wordmark.svgWordmark for the launch screen. Outlined from Geist, no font dependency.
og-1200x630.pngReplaces OG_Image.jpg as the share preview.
App iconNot an asset: extract from the APK on deploy. Every APK has one.
Launch videos, wallpapers, game tile, idle illustrationNo replacements. They stop rendering.
Both sides are reproductions rendered live, not screen captures. The left transcribes the real values — gradients, blur, timings, colours. The right is a proposal.
